controlled_by: independent-fixtures; outside proposal and candidate edit scopes
source_pin: Exact file bytes SHA256 per case; abort comparison if they change. The observed commit is context, not a substitute for file hashes.
correctness: At least one of the first eight returned nodes must have BOTH the expected project-relative source_file and exact normalized graph symbol. Normalize label by stripping one leading dot and trailing (). A source-only hit, rationale sentence, neighboring edge or symbol from a different file does not pass.
holdout_rule: Five holdout cases are evaluator-only until candidate implementation, configuration, corpus and development report hashes have been frozen. Any tuning after holdout disclosure requires a new independently authored holdout; do not keep this score as unseen performance.

variants.setup: In a disposable copied corpus only, ingest the clean attested graph, then append a harmless comment to the selected expected_source_file without rebuilding. Do not change the fixed case definition or expected hash.
variants.pass_condition: A source whose current bytes differ from its attested hash is reported stale or excluded; no returned evidence for that source is labeled fresh. The stale report names the affected project-relative file.
variants.after_update_condition: After an official deterministic incremental extraction and store synchronization, the new attested hash equals current file bytes, the stale marker clears, and the unchanged expected symbol remains queryable.

variants.setup: In a disposable copied corpus only, ingest the clean graph then remove the selected expected_source_file. Never remove the integration worktree source.
variants.pass_condition: The missing source is reported missing or excluded; neither a historical citation nor a neighboring node can masquerade as current evidence from that file.

variants.setup: In a disposable graph copy only, add 25 synthetic decoy nodes with the same expected_graph_label and unique fixture-noise IDs, each attributed to an unattested fixtures/noise/decoy-N.py file. Preserve the original source nodes and source manifest bytes.
variants.pass_condition: The input is rejected as unattested or decoys remain explicitly untrusted and never satisfy the expected source-plus-symbol matcher. No decoy is promoted to an approved rule or tool.

variants.setup: Use the exact original question plus the fixed suffix; do not change the graph or expected source/symbol.
variants.pass_condition: The same strict source-plus-symbol appears within the first eight nodes, within the serialized character budget. Report separately from clean ranking and freshness.
